race.comment: DOMINANT DARCY (5) pulled up with excuses when too bad to be true last time at Eagle Farm. Her first two runs of this prep were super and if she can rebound here she'll be in the finish. Like the Sunny Coast for her. TEQUILA BABY (2) is in winning touch and just hold her form to be right there again, though the wide gate will require a clever ride from the apprentice. AMUSEANTES (4) was plain last start, but her previous Doomben second reads well and the return to 1200m gives her a more suitable platform, while CHAMPAGNE LANE (8) has the chance to bounce back sharply with the blinkers going on first time.
